title: Good Knight - One-Button Bullet-Hell
description:
Geometry Dash meets Super Hexagon and Bullet-Hell Experience the legendary filipino ONE-BUTTON "Butt-Clenching" Bullet-Hell! A game that pushes as much emotion, adrenaline, challenge, and fun, with just ONE-BUTTON. A unique and crazy game found only in indie games 

Game Features• One-Button, infinite lives! The EASIEST to play bullet hell! - This game was intentionally made to make things easy to play with its innovative pickup and play One-Button gameplay, and infinite lives.

• Play to master it or just have fun! - Play the game for just for a quick experience and you still won't forget this game. But if you want to master it, experience a deep and complex scoring system made for arcade masters.

• How much can one button game make you feel? - Pain. Joy. Excitement. Drama. Butt-clenching. A rollercoaster and whirlwind of emotions experienced all in one-button bullet hell.

• Inspired by the best Bullet-Hell, Arcade, and Hyper Casual games - Such as Geometry Dash, Super Hexagon, Touhou, Cave Games, Undertale and more.

• A love letter to Philippine Mythlogies and Culture - Experience a unique story inspired by mythlogies, culture, and history found in the Philippines mixed with horror and gothic dark atmosphere. Influenced by Castlevania, Splatterhouse, Touhou, and Devil May Cry.  

• Award-winning metal music - Composed by LEAF XCEED Music Division. A love letter to Video Game Music in metal flavor.

• Solve Puzzle-Like Patterns - Challenge yourself with awesome puzzle-like bullet hell gameplay!

• Hypnotic Spiral Bullet-Hell Visuals - Hell never felt so captivating and beautiful with the thousands of hand-crafted bullet-hell patterns.
description_short: Geometry Dash meets Super Hexagon, in this ONE-BUTTON "Butt-Clenching" Bullet-Hell! Experience a rollercoaster of emotions as you experience filipino hell with its unique mechanics and Philippine mythology inspired story.
